**Source repository:** https://gitlab.com/myhospitalcore/a033_nuna_helper_netstandard

Browse that project for:

|-------|-------------------------------|
| CRUD interfaces | `data-access-helper.md` |
| Dapper helper | `dapper-helper.md` |
| MayBe monad | `maybe-monad.md` |
| Result monad | `result-monad.md` |
| Nuna ID | `nunaid.md` |
| Repository–DAL contract | `crud-repository-interface.md` |

Do not expect these files under `docs/` in **b09-bilreg-api**.
